text: Month Close Feature. I have been using this app 3 years and I love it. But the newest month close feature that forces your budget closed in two months is absurd. Life happens and you get behind on budgeting, sometimes you find an error and need to go back and change it. Let us lock/unlock the budget. Don’t force it locked and there’s nothing we can do! My budget is way out of wack now I can’t catch up on my transactions and close the budget out myself.

Unannounced changes. I used the every dollar app for years & recently they added a new feature that locks the previous budget months. I had no idea about the change and now I cannot close or reconcile September which is so frustrating. We get paid late sometimes because of being a sub contractor and this new feature is not going to allow us the time needed to finish a month, such a terrible idea with no fix available, support could not even help me re-open the month so I could complete it. Unfortunately we will need to find another app for budgeting.

Latest Update. The new closed budget feature has made this app basically useless for me. Was really great before that. Please add a toggle off for closed budgets. Many people have valid reasons to edit old budgets.

New updates screwed it up. Why does the new update close out months?  We had money to spend from some of the months this year and were waiting for a time we needed it. Now I can’t pull up that information. Why is the app making the decision to close months out and now screw up our budgets from earlier this year.

Update runes service I paid for.. A recent update majorly changed the way the app works. Now budgets are permanently locked 30 days after the end of the month. This was applied without warning and now my September budget is locked. Since I was gone most of October, September wasn’t completely finished and now it’s locked that way which cascades the error in to October and all future budgets. This basically ruins the app for me.

Worse, from what I can tell, this change happened with no warning days before the September deadline.

I’ve been paying for this app since 2016. There have been plenty of times where I catch an error beyond the 30 day limit. There have also been months where life gets busy and I fall a month behind. 

I’m not about to pay $80 a year to be bound by such a ridiculous, arbitrary, and micromanaging limit. If it is not changed post haste, I will find an alternative.

Decent content; poor app. It’s a good budget tool but has gone downhill. You’re locked out of older months so forget about fixing mistakes. The bank connection doesn’t update daily so you’re left with random updates. BOTH new “features” support admits.

6 years and now looking elsewhere(auto closing). I have used a loved and paid for this app for more than 6 years. I’m a huge numbers guy. The auto close feature has truly horrid. It’s my budget to allocated and adjust if needed. Especially refunds or account/cash transfers that take time. Praying this feature gets removed or has a turn off option before my annual subscription renewal. If not thank you for the years of help but I’ll be going elsewhere. Including my many other family members.

Used to be the best. I’m switching with the new update that limits access to your own data. I got behind, finally got time to catch up only to find my September budget is locked (it’s November 2nd). I just need to finish off a few transactions and balance September. I will not pay for a premium app where I can’t access my own budget. This has always been the best budgeting app, I have used it for 4-5 years (premium version for at least 3 years). Now I am forced to find another one, which sucks.

iPad App. It was an excellent app. But locking access to previous months is a deal breaker. While I understand that there are other apps, I’ve spent years building and maintaining my records on this one. Losing flexibility on this app is means losing years of work. It’s extremely frustrating that such a restrictive feature cannot be disabled.

App Good, Horrible Customer Service l. This app is great for budgeting. The customer service is HORRIBLE. It will take them forever to respond to a request and when they do, they don’t answer half of your questions. I’ve been asking for assistance for weeks now on why new features don’t update on my app even though I’m running the most current version.

They Abruptly Force Closed Prior Months. The owner of this budget management application decided to abruptly force close prior months meaning that one cannot go back and make any changes. This is a terrible mistake that will be costly to them as loyal users will seek an alternative. It doesn’t even make sense. It appears that anything older than the previous month is closed as soon as the first of the month starts. So on November 1st, one couldn’t make any changes to any day in September.

Over-Complicated. I really want to love this app, but it’s just far too complicated. My paychecks don’t align with the first day of every month and there is not enough flexibility for me to get a handle on my cash flow under this system. I don’t care for the paycheck planner function, I can’t link my credit union, and the sinking fund functionality doesn’t really make sense.

They should have left it alone. I have used this app for years, but they keep making changes to it and by changing it they are making it much more complicated and non-User friendly. I’m going to delete it at this point and look for another app.

Update with closing budgets. I don’t like the update that closes the budget on months over 2 months old. It’s very inconvenient for when life gets busy and I need to go back on previous months to reconcile them

The Only Budgeting Tool You Need!. I've been using EveryDollar to track my expenses for over 10 years now. I used the free version for the first 7 years, and that had helped me become completely debt free. I'm now paying the annual subscription to automate tracking my transactions and has been loving it. Keep using the free version if you're on the journey to become debt free; the less your overall subscriptions, the better. Only when you're able to, then check out the paid features.

Locked out. They recently rolled out a lock out feature… I have been going back and updating this past year to get a true picture and when me and my husband are like well we prefer to see this in a different group I update it so the insights are correct and now I’m locked out; I’m so made I wish I could get my money back!!

Please Allow Users to Reopen and Edit Previous Budgets. I’ve used EveryDollar for years, and the new policy preventing edits to budgets older than two months creates a serious problem for users who need to reconcile past transactions.

I hadn’t finished assigning all my September income and expenses before November started, and now I can’t complete that budget. Because I use multiple bank accounts, credit cards, and sinking funds, this also affects my ability to accurately track fund balances and carry money forward into October.

I understand the need to protect rollover calculations, but permanently locking previous months shouldn’t be the solution. Please add an option to reopen closed budgets and automatically recalculate affected balances in subsequent months. Even a warning explaining that editing a previous month will affect future budgets would be reasonable.

At the very least, users should have a way to request an unlock, complete their reconciliation, and update their fund balances without manually rebuilding everything in another month.

Budgeting doesn’t always happen on a perfect schedule, and users need the flexibility to correct their financial records. I genuinely want to continue using EveryDollar, but this restriction makes accurate budgeting unnecessarily difficult. Please reconsider this policy and provide a practical way to edit and reconcile older months.

Great App. Bad Updare. I love using this app to track my monthly income and expenses. However, a recent update automatically locked my budgets from previous months, making it impossible to adjust past transactions. Since I often have late transactions to categorize, this new feature is really frustrating. It would be great if locking past budgets was an optional setting that could be toggled on or off.

Get rid of the “close budget” feature. I can understand why the Ramsey method would prescribe not being able to edit past months budgets, but it’s super frustrating to not have the flexibility to adjust past transactions and budget items. I’m probably going to use a different service and not renew my subscription unless this “feature” is removed.
Transactions. App rarely connects with transactions. They need to fix this. I am a big supporter of Ramsey products and this just is cheap

Bring back the old version. The new updates make everything more complicated. I want a simple way to keep track of my spending, not something that takes a long time to do. We have a paycheck every two weeks. I’ve always titled those by the date they will come in, but now Every Dollar makes it difficult to change titles from month to month. I have to delete one category and create a new one. I get constant pushes for learning pathways that I don’t need or ads to buy the full version. Please bring back the old, simple version as an option.

Horrible updates. Guys this was such a good app, and I’m very sad that you’ve changed it. I’ve been using it for years but the update is such horrible UI that I’m going to try to get a refund and try a different budget app. 

What changed?

1. Required “budget closing”

This makes the app way too rigid and then messes with your next months budget without an option to turn it off. When you have a month that doesn’t really make sense or you forgot to track, it makes starting over for the next month IMPOSSIBLE and incredibly confusing. I DO NOT want it to “add” money to the next months budget for me. If you want it to be an OPTION, sure, but to make it mandatory is horrible!!

2. Tracked transactions don’t disappear anymore 

This just makes tracking transactions really confusing. Before, when you tracked a transaction it would disappear into a separate folder.  It was satisfying. Now it’s just one long overwhelming list :/

Sad to say I won’t be renewing my every dollar subscription as this features render the app unusable. If they get rid of them, or make them optional, please let me know. Been a regular user of this app since 2022 :(

New update is terrible. The monthly close locks your budget and you cannot edit it. It also carries over leftover budget which is not how I handle my budget! I cancelled my subscription. So sad because I’ve been using it for years. Hopefully they remove the monthly close feature or at least make it optional

Long time disappointed user. The app had been working very well for a long time. It’s been my go to. After this last update. The math isn’t working. Whenever I enter a transaction, it turns it red and tells me that I have that amount remaining instead of taking it off the total for that month or that item this needs to be fixed ASAP.

Bad changes. I’ve used this app since it was released and have been very happy with it. However this latest update that locks budgets more than two months old completely breaks my workflow. We don’t need you to judge us for when we budget, just give us flexibility to budget when we can. Sometime I get a few months behind but I always catch myself up.  Now I can’t. I’ll have to cancel my subscription and go somewhere else.

It started fine and got worse. I’ve been using this app several years; it was fine.  It was good for what it was; tracking expenses day-to-day.  That information doesn’t need to be stored online, but it was fine.
Over the years the app has gotten more and more bloated, slower to use, and harder to use, and they’ve been pushing more and more for the premium subscription.
Now suddenly they’ve locked off previous months; you can no longer put in transactions from three months ago.  Why?  Dunno, but this finally pushed me over to finding a better app.

Life changing. EveryDollar has genuinely changed my life! This app has a way of calling me out with my spending like “woah girl reel it in, it’s only the 10th of the month”! The team who works on this app knows my needs before I even do! HIGHLY recommend EveryDollar to anyone who wants to be financially responsible and get out of debt!!! P.s. this new month close feature so I can look forward …. GENIUS

Was great, but the budget closing feature ruined everything. I used EveryDollar for over a year and it helped me so much in managing my finances. However, they just recently added a budget closing feature. While the feature in and of itself is not a bad idea, it completely restructures the app in a way that conflicts with how I’ve used it in the past. I used to be able to edit past budgets and return to them, which I used to keep track of leftover money or determine when I was still owed some. Also, if I was not able to review a previous month’s budget, I could use the new one until I had time to catch up with my finances. I am immensely disappointed by this new update. I hope they change this feature to be optional. If not, I may just need to find a new budgeting app.

They have ruined it. I will be deleting this app.  They have made recent changes which make it worthless.   Once you are over budget, adding expenses in the past changed the over budget amount.    It no longer does that.   Also, they’ve taken away the ability to see at a glance at the top what you planned, spent and how much is remaining.   You know have to scroll down and it’s not as easy to see at a glance where you stand.    I have no idea why they would make these negative changes, but the app no longer works for me.

Tap-to-top!!. Please enable Apple’s very known and convenient tap-to-top on the Budget and Today menus. It’s very annoying having to manually scroll all the way back to the top. The Transactions and Accounts have the functionality enabled.

App Amazing!. It has been an amazing tool to organize prioritize and manage spending. I really appreciate it! I’m pretty frugal and use the free version and find great value in the tool. I’m sure the Premium version is great, but not willing to splurge at this point.

Use a spreadsheet instead!. This is not very practical. I have been using a spreadsheet to track my spending for the past year. It makes perfect sense. It’s comprehensive. This app is too simplistic. It doesn’t come close to including all the options needed to cover the variety of expenses that I have. Also, I AM HAVING DIFFICULTY CANCELLING. That should never be the case. I am going to end up paying $18 a month for this!

Closes each month without notice. The app is great except they rolled out an update that closes previous months & make them UN-editable. Without any warning. For some this may be fine, but sometimes I throw extra money at the end of the month into a few different sinking funds. Or wait to transfer the savings until after the month is over.  Or say one month we spend more money on clothes at the beginning of school and then the next month we don’t, the sinking funds help keep track of saving some each month. Or say you didn’t spend all your money in a category, you can’t adjust the budget lower and put the money somewhere else after they “close” that months. What a joke! I want a refund.

Don’t waste your time. It calculate all my expenses wrong, I pay $80 but telling me I pay $28 and then saying I’m over budget but my monthly rent $927 monthly… how I’m over budget ? That rent money keep roof over my head ???

Terrible, just terrible. I have not  been able to log into my bank accounts for months now using plaid. So I have Dave Ramsey $80 dollars for nothing! I can’t even get a refund. Well played Dave, well played! Don’t just stay away from this app, run away! I’m not the only person with this problem. Google it and see how many others have it as well. Please don’t fall for the scam app
Budgeting system down. The budgeting app has crashed in the month of October. Please fix promptly. Thanks
Never got on line or called me or wasn’t on zoom. Very disappointing

I don’t like the new update. The app was pretty good before and was relatively customizable but with this new update you’re literally not allowed to delete certain categories. I don’t track my emergency fund through this app but when it updated it had added the emergency fund line back plus put an amount in. When I try to delete it so my budget isn’t crowded with lines I don’t use, I get a pop up telling me I can’t delete it because emergency savings is important and I should be doing it. It feels like I’m getting lectured by an app.

You’re not even allowed to change the name of the emergency fund and use it for something else. It just has to sit there, empty and cluttering up the budget lines. 

I pay $17.99 monthly for this app. I should be able to customize it as much as I like. 

What was really needed instead in this update was the ability to put biweekly paychecks on a consistent schedule so you don’t need to go in on the first of every month and change the date on each paycheck and then go literally line by line and change the income date for each budget line. I wish you could just select “Biweekly pay schedule” and put in the first dates and then it calculates that your next pay will be in two more weeks.

Plaid connection is terrible. I use a robinhood credit card and am frequently missing many transactions and occasionally seeing duplicate transactions with the paid version of every dollar. The only reason we paid for premium is for automatic transaction tracking, however the tracking feature barely works. The only way to tell transactions are missing is to manually check every single transaction against your bank statement. Therefore making the automated tracking useless. I contacted support and they told me to manually track my transactions and that I’m not eligible for a refund. Even though the app literally does not do what it promised. Every dollar is trying to pawn off the blame on plaid. Everydollar, don’t use plaid if it doesn’t work. Figure out how to make it work or don’t offer premium as an option since you can’t deliver on it. DO BETTER DAVE RAMSEY.
Latest Update. I don’t like the big black underlined GREEN words for each budget section. I believe it was added in last 48 hours.
There is help!. I needed a lot of help. The help is so great and it’s free!!!

Disappointing Lack of iPhone Duo Optimization. I use this app every day, and it’s frustrating that it still hasn’t been properly optimized for the new iPhone Duo and its foldable display. For such a widely used app, I would expect better support for new devices, especially when it comes to full-screen functionality and taking advantage of the larger unfolded display.

It’s disappointing that users can’t fully enjoy the app on their new phones. I hope the developers take this seriously and prioritize releasing an optimized update as soon as possible. Until then, the lack of proper support significantly affects the overall experience.

Needs improvement but great app. The main thing I think is needed is a visible “Note” area at the top of each month. Rather than trying to remember why you budgeted extra in certain categories it’d be great if you could have some room to write “fair, anniversary, property taxes due, etc.”

Phone Bill?. I have the free version and I can’t find where to add the phone bill. No option to put dates on bills that I can figure out either. I’m trying to get out of debt so I can’t justify the price tag on the premium version.

If you get a subscription through your employer get ready to be frustrated. I got this as an app package available from my employer. My employer spends money every quarter per person subscriptions but every time they update the app the subscription goes please contact support your subscriptions have lapsed. Since they update the app so much I am always having issues. I had to unsubscribe because it was such a time suck to troubleshoot.

Nice & easy. I’ve been using the app for several months now in place of a spreadsheet. Easy to use. One suggestion I have is to allow us to choose a different start date for the planning month. I get paid once a month on the 20th of every month, so that’s really when my budget resets - not on the 1st of each month. Makes it a little trickier. Otherwise, great! Thanks!

Great Organizer. Have used for years  and have had very few issues with it. Appreciate the ability to make the plans flexible by creating different categories and tracking lines.

Is there a chance that a different budget style format would become available? My wife and I are paid every two weeks and the app feels like it’s set up for a house that gets paid once a month.

Great app. I love this app , the peace of mind factor and seeing when I can move funds over using paycheck planning is super valuable.

I just wish that for paychecks there were an option to say paychecks are every two weeks and set a start date and let the system determine when funds will be ready exactly , right now I leave it as 1st and 15th but that’s not accurate it’s more of paychecks come in every 2 fridays, but can’t choose that as an option, please add. Thanks!

Banking Connectivity Issue. I am currently utilizing the trial period and have found the app to be significantly problematic - I have link by banking, via Plaid, and it does NOT update transactions. I have manually entered transactions for days, and find this absurd, considering this is part of the “paid” function (and I’ve paid considering you MUST enter payment info to obtain trial period). Further, there is not a “delete” option for any line item you may have entered correctly; users aren’t able to relocate budget lines between categories - overall, this app seems highly non user friendly and if this functionality doesn’t improve over the course of the next week, I’ll be cancelling.

So frustrated. I’ve used this app for 5 years with only a hiccup here and there. However, today it suddenly gives me a blank green screen. I tried every recommended fix and nothing works. I’m extremely frustrated because even though o can still access my budget on my MacBook, that’s not how I use it. I use the app on my iPhone. It won’t let me log in to the website on my phone. It goes straight to the app which again, is a blank green screen. I use it on the go and don’t carry my MacBook everywhere I go.

Update: the issue is fixed for the most part. It still occasionally goes blank but I’m able to log out and log back in and it works fine. It’s annoying if I’m in a hurry but not a deal breaker considering how useful this app actually is.

Developer Fixed the issue! Thanks. Works great now!. 10/9 Update!  Issue resolved!

I haven’t used this in a while, thought I would try again. Entered everything for the moth. Took a couple hours. Then when I went back in to review and add a transaction, it would not open past a green blank screen. I contacted the AI help. They said it was on my end, funny, I don’t have issues with any of my apps. But I deleted the app and it reloaded. Then used it and it now crashed again.

Another dream would be a chart every month to see cash flow, but I see I need to pay for that. I get it….., but it isn’t in the budget. It’s still super helpful without a printout!

Great Budget App.. This is a very good budget ad. I really like the interface and how easy it is to use. It is something very simple and very powerful at the same time. Some things I would like to see in the app, even if I have to pay a little bit more: new notifications when a budget category goes beyond my expenses limit, new notifications when new transaction hit the app, ability to categorize pending spending transactions, ability to create rules to cancel a transaction like when moving money from checking to savings account and vice versa. (This is to avoid so many duplicates.)

This one is a maybe: in the home tab, create the ability to track net worth; so we can connect our investment accounts, and then we can track how we are doing.

Love it, wish it had subtotals. I switched from YNAB to EveryDollar a few years ago, and I love it. Simple, worth paying for the auto transactions. The only thing I miss from YNAB is being able to see the subtotals of each budget category (housing, transportation, etc.). I like seeing the percentage in the budget summary, but seeing the subtotals as I give each dollar its job would be nice, too.

Change. I have loved this app for 6 years now. I religiously moved my widgets to the budget item every day. With 4 kids and a busy house, this helped me stay on top of my budget. Well just this summer they switched to plaid to connect to your bank instead of connecting directly. It goes through a third party and plaid is a mess. It misses some of my purchases especially over the weekends. They are delayed even though it say in my bank that it’s been processed. It’s made me totally miscalculate my budget to the point of dropping negative because well you make an EveryDollar budget so if you over spend on one item without knowing you’re screwed. Bring back the old way please. I’ve been looking at other apps. I’m looking at you Dave Ramsey

Refresh still doesn’t work. For the past few months, I always see a number in my app like I have to resolve a transaction.  The number is always wrong.  It always has two extra “transactions “ that are not there when I actually open the app.  This is a thing all day long.    Very annoying to see that red number and nothing to actually resolve.  Please fix this!  My phone and my app are at the latest update.

Difficult to cancel. I attempted to cancel the introductory subscription several times before I was charged for a full year. This app does NOT show under Apple subscriptions. The help feature on the website directs me back to Apple to
cancel! It’s a HUGE contradiction for an app that’s advertised to help
with fiscal responsibility to actually be a subscription trap. Do better, Dave Ramsey!!!!!!
It Really Does Work. At first I thought it was complicated. After a couple of weeks using Eveydollar, I got the hang of it. I would like to see fireworks when I pay off a debt item.
The best!. This app is phenomenal!

EXPENSIVE. i got this to try and help me make a budget. you can’t assign bills that are due at different paces. like if one is a weekly bill or a monthly, you can’t separate. you just have to set it up as a monthly cost. this throws things off. also REALLY pushing that yearly membership. nearly $20 for a monthly cost is CRAZY for a budgeting app.

Needs some features. It’s difficult to view previous months transactions, it would be nice on October 1 to be able to see Sept 30th transactions without completely switching months. Easier to see trends and when you bought something. Also in the accounts section to be able to set negative balances on bank accounts

Please. Fix. The. Badge!. I’ve been complaining about the badge being wrong all the time for the last several updates—for perhaps a year. I can tell you’ve done something but it’s still consistently wrong, just wrong in a different way. Aggravating.

The app is mostly good. But the app badge is really screwed up. It shows that there are transactions to log when there are none or else the number is wrong. If there are any, after I log them, a couple minutes later the badge shows that there 3 new transactions, but there are always none. It does this consistently.

If it shows a number of transactions to log at other times (not the 3 it shows right after I’ve logged all transactions), the number of actual transactions is always one fewer than what the badge indicates.

The badge is almost always wrong now. Completely unreliable.

Irritating. I pay a LOT of money for this service, so please fix.

Thank you for keeping individual categories. Thank you for keeping individual categories as part of the “spending” umbrella! I enjoy having all of my stuff separated by category! Keeps things more organized

Funds and Savings. Everything works fine but I wish there was a way to transfer money within the app instead of having to make two transactions to show that you moved money from one account to another. Also there should be a way to make savings goals that can be updated as you put the money in and can also be carried over to the next month.
The Dollar App. Seems like a great application.     7 day trial was great. My only concern is $80.00 bucks year.  To me, should be free in helping folks get out of debt.  Not just 7 days.

Broken. It appears the app updated yesterday and now it will not
Load past a green screen. I use the app everyday. This has never happened. If I delete and reinstall, I’m warned that I’ll lose all my data. I like it otherwise. Please fix this and I will update the review. I

Way to contact you about the problem since the app
Won’t load. I did restart my phone. Thanks!
App not loading. App is not wanting to load when I try to open it on iPhone
App won’t open. The app won’t open and it’s infuriating
Not functional. App won't open after the new update

Cancel. I just downloaded this app and didn’t realize there was a trial period and then a charge . I only put a small amount of information in . The trial is not showing up in apple subscriptions . How do I cancel the trial. I do not want to be charged

Stop prompting me to subscribe. I love this app and have used it for years - it's a great budgeting tool and helps us easily track expenses and forecast future months. My gripe? Stop the prompt to get me to subscribe to the paid version literally everytime I open the app. I'm trying to...save money. 🤔 The free version is fine. I'm happy with it. If I want to start paying for it I will!

I’m looking for another budget app. How can you possibly keep making this app worse with every update. I’ve had this for at least six years and it consistently keeps getting worse. Who in the heck is in charge? Why do we have to jump through all these hoops to move stuff around and push five different buttons just to put an expense in. And why the heck can I not use the same wording in a different month. Is that really that big of a deal?!

Recent updates have made the app soo much better!. Recent updates have been so good! The app is MUCH faster, frustrating things from previous versions like small tap targets has also been fixed and I love the calculator part where I can quickly add 2 things together in the field. I liked the app before, but it soo much better! Thanks for putting the hard work and time into making it even better!

Support Team reads our comments. After a previous update removed the “raw” transaction data from the financial institution, I commented that I’d like to see it returned because the sale transaction date is more important to me than the closing date. And…it has returned! It’s not pretty, but it’s useful. I like the calculator and the option to see pending transactions as well. Now, let’s see the long lost widget return and add transfers to the mobile apps.

Good budgeting app. It’s a good app, but I’m still absolutely bewildered that there isn’t a way to filter for un labeled transactions. It seems like the most basic function in my mind, but is such a nuisance to not have

Too much tinkering. Ive used this app for about 7 years. Imo it was fine and a great app about 5 years ago and then they started regularly making changes to it. Its not that complicated of a concept but someone is always messing around and trying to change the way something looks or functions. This latest update with the calculator on the keyboard is just really stupid. Why would you need a calculator when you are recording transactions?! It makes it too tricky to use for older folks like me who can barely type on these phones. Im going to just make a spreadsheet and use that if the developers keep getting creative. Please guys, just keep it simple. Know a good thing when you have it and let it be. Otherwise, very useful. I credit this app above all else with me having a firm grip on my money.

Would be great but…. Simple and easy to use. It doesn’t require you to link your bank accounts which is exactly what I wanted- I prefer to manually enter my transactions. Unfortunately it keeps logging me out and losing months of budgets when I log back in making it unusable. Logging back in is annoying enough on its own but each time it deletes 10+ months of budgets and transactions including the current month. It does this maybe every 1.5 to 2 months so I gave it a couple more chances in case it was a glitch that just happened once or twice but nope. It happened again. Deleted all of my budgets and transactions from December 2025 to current day (Sept 2026). And it’s almost the end of the month so I’m not going to go back in and redo weeks of transactions just for this to happen again in a month or two.

Have a suggestion. Love the app. However, would like to see when you are over budget on  a specific line item that it is calculated into your  total budget at top of app. When I see something over budget, I end up just typing the total amount spent to not be over budget and making adjustments as needed to other line items. To me that doesn’t allow me to totally get the big picture of where I need to make adjustments for the next month

Moderate. The app is easy to use, however, I have an issue with the subscription part. I did the in app purchase of the 14 day free trail and it doesn’t show up that I started it. It keeps saying that need to sign up for it. Overall decent app, easy to understand and whatnot, just a little bit annoying on the subscription side (which you don’t have to get, you just don’t get access to every part of the app).

Overall great app, I’d like to suggest a key adjustment:. I really enjoy the app, however I am a strong believer in the saying “garbage in - garbage out” when it comes to providing relevant data. Specifically, I see an area where I believe we can fine tune data input in order to get better data output, thus, giving the user a better experience. For instance, when using “Paycheck Planning” the current feature splits a bi-weekly paycheck right down the middle at 50%, I would like it to instead be adjustable for those of us who receive a larger paycheck at the end of the month compared to our first paycheck of the month. 

What might this look like? Picture this: Billy Bob is an hourly paid employee and makes $10,000 net each month. Billy Bob is paid bi-weekly, however, his last paycheck of the month factors the entire months “per diem” as well as any overtime hours. Let say 25% of the total $10,000 monthly paycheck is paid on the 3rd of the month, while the other 75% of his paycheck ($7,500) is paid on the 17th of the month. This isn’t currently factored into the Every Dollar app and can make budgeting difficult.

For example: the default view of this app should not be the “today” page. This is a learning summary page. It should be in the back of the deck where I can access it when I want to learn or view summaries. In fact, you should probably just get rid of it all together, since you have other tabs dedicated for those purposes.

The most useful page on this app, to be used on the daily, is the budget section. A most common use case is for me to want to buy something… Not know how much I have left in my envelope for that thing… And eopening my app in order to get answers. That is what prevents overspending. Instant information sharing. Not Some page doggedly trying to get me to use the tutorial system.

This brings me to my second criticism: why do the pages not seem to speak to each other consistently? If I’ve created dozens of budgets in this app, why am I still being asked to “get started on my first budget”? There does not seem to be any manual way to correct this misinformation. I simply must go through the tutorial in order to get rid of that call to action. so now, not only do I have an annoying default page that I have to scroll past in order to get to relevant information, but the information it’s giving me isn’t even valid. 




third, and this is a big one: assigning transactions to envelopes takes way too long. Here is the process: 1. Click transaction. 2. Visually find the small, nondescript section that allows you to assign it to an envelope. Click that. 3. Click the search bar. (Because nobody wants to visually scroll past dozens of fund titles, guys). 4. Search for the right envelope. click it. 5. Press done. to go back to the data page. 6. Press done AGAIN to fully assign the transaction. 

I understand that you created the fast track function to try to make this better. But let’s be real, it’s only correct about 30% of the time. And in a world where we can simply swipe left or right to find a love match, I simply must believe that there is a faster way to getting this tedious process done. Here’s a suggestion that won’t require a complete architectural rewrite:

1. Click on transaction. If we must default to the transaction data page, fine, but the search bar is on that page. Furthermore, the search bar is immediately in focus, allowing us to 
2. Instantly start typing the name of the fund. Similar to Excel‘s filter function, funds that are caught by the search are instantly selected.
3. Big, noticeable, DONE button. Not some tiny white font up in the corner.

That’s it. onto the next transaction. 

There is so much needless stuff shoved onto this transaction data page that could be moved to a second page. you need some of it to remember what the transaction was about. But…a “share transaction” button?? Big and bold, where the “DONE” button probably should be? while the “done” button gets shoved into the tiny upper-right corner? a check# section? even notes are unnecessary at this stage. You’re trying to be helpful, but at the cost of slowing down a daily, predictable, repeatable process that you’re also asking everybody to invest in as a habit. In other words, it’s bad design to code for the exceptions rather than the most common use case.

there’s additional stuff… bank transactions still take way too long to show up, funds are clunky to work with, the app consistently signs me out… for reasons unknown to me… every couple of days I need to sign back in…

Like I said. I’m grateful for it, but it needs work, and I’d love to see some of these essential, time-eating design flaws getting addressed, rather than a new dark mode.

Free Version. I really enjoy this app for its simplicity and customizability. It’s pretty bare bones, but you don’t need much if you are already fiscally responsible and just need a tracker. However, there’s one element that absolutely drives me bonkers: the funds. I understand the purpose of the planned category; that’s not my issue. Whenever you log a transaction against the fund, it updates the balance as expected (positive or negative). But It also updates the total remaining amount to spend for the entire monthly budget, and it drives me bonkers! For example, if I log an unexpected $1000 charge against my emergency fund (25k total), that fund will be updated to $24k but the monthly budget will say I’m $1k overbudget. Same thing if I have an unexpected windfall of $5000 that I add to the fund; it’ll say I have $5000 more to spend for that month. It can make it really confusing because I just want a snapshot of how I’m doing for the month excluding extraneous transactions. I just wish it would keep funds separate. I just log my savings as a line item and then do the funds in a spreadsheet because it’s so frustrating, Some additional graphs in the free tier would be a nice update too. (And it seems to be available in other free apps). For example, you can see the pie chart split by category for the current month (housing, lifestyle, etc) but you currently can’t scroll back to previous months. I can’t say if there are more features with the paid version, but these elements stood out to me.
